## PR Description

`heartbeat()` returned one bool for three different worlds: a readable foreign bootId (real loss), a failed sidecar READ, and a failed WRITE/rename. Any transient fs hiccup therefore self-demoted the OWNER to viewer — printed `lease: lost — another host is driving this session` (a lie), and the viewer-mode early-return in the inbox tick stopped presence, orphan reclaim, scheduled mail and child mail while the still-held session kept being written (#2248-class incident, observed 2026-11-17).

## Change

- **`FileSessionLeaseStore.heartbeat` → `LeaseBeat`** (sealed, `session_lease.dart`):
  - `LeaseBeatRenewed` — refresh landed (E5: verified on disk).
  - `LeaseBeatIoFailed(error)` — read hiccup (bounded re-reads, `notFound` short-circuits), torn/corrupt body, or failed write/rename. **Ownership is KEPT; the next beat retries.** A failed refresh re-reads the sidecar to classify: still ours → hiccup, never demote.
  - `LeaseBeatLost(lease?)` — a readable foreign bootId (demotes on the FIRST beat, no ownership zombie), or a verified-absent sidecar (a deletion is not transient — a rival may acquire any moment).
- **One guard at the verdict** (`agent_cli_viewer.dart` `_leaseHeartbeat`): only `LeaseBeatLost` runs the demote path; `LeaseBeatIoFailed` counts consecutive failures and alarms every 3rd (`lease heartbeat failing — fs error: <raw errno> (ownership kept; retrying)`) without touching the owner role. Presence/orphan-reclaim/scheduled-mail inherit the fix — they are gated on viewer mode, which an IO hiccup can no longer enter.
- E5 fallback (no-rename backends) keeps single-write + post-write verify; written-but-unprovable is now an IO anomaly (kept + alarm), not a demote. The CLI never heartbeats on `LeaseUnenforced` (no held path), so desktop is the live surface.

## Tests (red-first)

- `session_lease_test.dart` new group `heartbeat separates IO failure from loss (#2257)`: one-beat read hiccup retries+renews; persistent read failure → `IoFailed` carrying the raw fs error, sidecar untouched; failed refresh re-read keeps ownership and the next beat retries; readable foreign sidecar demotes on the first beat; verified-absent demotes. Existing heartbeat assertions migrated to the beat API; renew/expire/release REG paths unchanged (all 27 green).
- `agent_cli_viewer_test.dart` `#2257: a heartbeat sidecar IO hiccup does NOT demote the owner`: red-first — on main the first failed beat demoted (viewer early-return killed the beat loop, alarm never fired, test timed out); now the alarm re-fires while the failure persists, no `another host is driving` lie, no viewer transition, sidecar still names us. The REG mid-run demote test (real loss) passes unchanged.

Gates (standalone SDK in worktree): `dart analyze` on all six touched files — no issues; `dart format` exact; both lease test files green.

Fixes #2257

# Review Policy

Preset: `default` — resolved from: built-in default (resolution chain: projectConfig.reviewPolicy → workflow jobParams → built-in default).
Verification: `none` — findings post exactly as the review leg raised them — no second-stage verification.
Every verdict on this PR is traceable to this table.

| Severity | Round | Fix | Gates approval |
|---|---|---|---|
| 🚨 BLOCKING | rework | mandatory | YES |
| ⚠️ IMPORTANT | rework | mandatory | YES |
| 💡 SUGGESTION | polish | mandatory | no |
| 🪶 NIT | none | opportunistic | no |

Verification: `none` — findings post exactly as the review leg raised them — no second-stage verification.

Bounds: polishMaxThreads=6 · polishMaxChangedLines=80 · opportunisticMaxThreads=8 · opportunisticSameFilesOnly=true · densityMin=2 · densityMax=8 · sweepBatch=10 · sweepMaxAgeDays=30

Density cap (💡/🪶 threads only; 🚨/⚠️ never capped): allowed = clamp(round(2 + 3*sqrt(additions/200)), 2, 8).
Rank your findings and post the top-K as threads; the overflow becomes a ranked digest list in the general comment. The census counts posted threads + digest lines.

Machine enforcement: the approval is recomputed from the severity census + this policy — the model verdict is advisory. Any 🚨 or ⚠️ open → REQUEST_CHANGES; only 💡/🪶 → APPROVE.
## Downgrade protocol

A rework lap may downgrade a specific ⚠️ IMPORTANT finding to 💡 SUGGESTION **only with a written justification** in the census (the thread reply and the response summary: why this is not maintainability debt). A silent downgrade does not exist: the next review round re-raises it as ⚠️ IMPORTANT and the cycle repeats. A justified downgrade lets a false-⚠️ review converge to APPROVE without a code change.

```dart
_heldLeasePath = null;          // line 399 — no `_viewer != null` check
...
await _enterViewerMode(...)     // line 404 — overwrites `_viewer`
```

`_enterViewerMode` assigns `_viewer = attachment` without disposing the
previous one, and `_releaseSessionLease` disposes only the current `_viewer`.
So the second demote leaks the first attachment's `StreamSubscription`
forever — duplicated transcript rows from two live `FileSessionEventSource.watch`
streams for the rest of the session.

This is realistic, not hypothetical: a sidecar read stall longer than
`staleAfter` (15s) makes the unrefreshed lease go stale, a waiting rival
acquires, and then *every* queued beat deterministically classifies `Lost` —
N beats → N demotes → N−1 leaked subscriptions. The #2257 incident itself
proves multi-second fs hangs happen here.

Suggested fix (matches the guard pattern `_claimSessionLease` already uses):

```dart
case LeaseBeatLost():
  _leaseBeatFailures = 0;
}
if (_viewer != null) return; // a demote already ran — never re-enter
_heldLeasePath = null;
```

(or an `_leaseBeatInFlight` bool set before `store.heartbeat` and cleared on
completion, which also stops beat pile-up during the stall itself).

# pr-2300: fix(2257): lease heartbeat no longer conflates sidecar IO failure with lost ownership

## Description

`heartbeat()` returned one bool for three different worlds: a readable foreign bootId (real loss), a failed sidecar READ, and a failed WRITE/rename. Any transient fs hiccup therefore self-demoted the OWNER to viewer — printed `lease: lost — another host is driving this session` (a lie), and the viewer-mode early-return in the inbox tick stopped presence, orphan reclaim, scheduled mail and child mail while the still-held session kept being written (#2248-class incident, observed 2026-11-17).

## Change

- **`FileSessionLeaseStore.heartbeat` → `LeaseBeat`** (sealed, `session_lease.dart`):
  - `LeaseBeatRenewed` — refresh landed (E5: verified on disk).
  - `LeaseBeatIoFailed(error)` — read hiccup (bounded re-reads, `notFound` short-circuits), torn/corrupt body, or failed write/rename. **Ownership is KEPT; the next beat retries.** A failed refresh re-reads the sidecar to classify: still ours → hiccup, never demote.
  - `LeaseBeatLost(lease?)` — a readable foreign bootId (demotes on the FIRST beat, no ownership zombie), or a verified-absent sidecar (a deletion is not transient — a rival may acquire any moment).
- **One guard at the verdict** (`agent_cli_viewer.dart` `_leaseHeartbeat`): only `LeaseBeatLost` runs the demote path; `LeaseBeatIoFailed` counts consecutive failures and alarms every 3rd (`lease heartbeat failing — fs error: <raw errno> (ownership kept; retrying)`) without touching the owner role. Presence/orphan-reclaim/scheduled-mail inherit the fix — they are gated on viewer mode, which an IO hiccup can no longer enter.
- E5 fallback (no-rename backends) keeps single-write + post-write verify; written-but-unprovable is now an IO anomaly (kept + alarm), not a demote. The CLI never heartbeats on `LeaseUnenforced` (no held path), so desktop is the live surface.

## Tests (red-first)

- `session_lease_test.dart` new group `heartbeat separates IO failure from loss (#2257)`: one-beat read hiccup retries+renews; persistent read failure → `IoFailed` carrying the raw fs error, sidecar untouched; failed refresh re-read keeps ownership and the next beat retries; readable foreign sidecar demotes on the first beat; verified-absent demotes. Existing heartbeat assertions migrated to the beat API; renew/expire/release REG paths unchanged (all 27 green).
- `agent_cli_viewer_test.dart` `#2257: a heartbeat sidecar IO hiccup does NOT demote the owner`: red-first — on main the first failed beat demoted (viewer early-return killed the beat loop, alarm never fired, test timed out); now the alarm re-fires while the failure persists, no `another host is driving` lie, no viewer transition, sidecar still names us. The REG mid-run demote test (real loss) passes unchanged.

Gates (standalone SDK in worktree): `dart analyze` on all six touched files — no issues; `dart format` exact; both lease test files green.

Fixes #2257

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. This file is
the agent ENTRY document: the harness merges it into the system prompt with
a ~19 KB entry budget, so it must stay small enough to be fully visible.
Ceiling: **≤ 300 lines / ≤ 20 KB** — enforced by
`scripts/check_agents_md_size.sh` (pre-commit hook via `ci_fast_gate.sh` +
the CI `static` job). Subsystem essays live in `docs/` — index:
`docs/README.md`. Keep entries factual: paths, commands, invariants.

## Module map

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph CORE["SDK - flutter_agent_harness, pure Dart (lib/)"]
        AI["ai: providers, agent loop, sessions, compaction"]
        TOLS["tools: approval, redact, hashline, memory"]
        HOSTS["hosts: shared wiring, messaging, a2a, hub"]
    end
    subgraph PKG["packages/ - sibling Dart packages"]
        FAUI["fa_ui: widgets incl. trajectory"]
        DAP["dap_hub, fa_llm, fa_llm_mock"]
    end
    CLI["fa CLI - bin/ + lib/src/cli: TUI, slash commands, headless"]
    APP["Flutter app - flutter_app/: desktop, mobile, web shells"]
    EXT["Browser extension - browser_ext/ + lib/src/browser + serve_bridge"]
    OFFICE["Office add-in - office_addin/ + FA_HOST=office host"]
    GOLDEN["UI golden & styles - golden tests, themes, ui tests"]
    NETW["fa_network - external Go backend + network clients"]
    CORE --> CLI
    CORE --> APP
    CORE --> EXT
    PKG --> APP
    PKG --> CLI
    APP --> OFFICE
    CLI --> NETW
    APP --> NETW
    EXT --> NETW
    GOLDEN --> APP
    GOLDEN --> FAUI
```

## Project layout — one line per subsystem

Full subsystem reference: `docs/agents/sdk-subsystems.md` (SDK) +
`docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md` (app/packages/repo-level).

**SDK core (`lib/`, pure Dart):**

- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers, session modes, per-tool overrides, critical-bash interceptor, per-turn grants.
- `lib/src/tools/` — `ask`/`request_secret`/media tools, `read` selectors + archives + sqlite, background shell jobs, availability + load modes.
- `lib/src/env/` — `ExecutionEnv` impls: `LocalShell` (setsid, killTree, drain caps, self-signal immunity), session-correlation vars, in-memory default.
- `lib/src/agent/` — FinalizeGate, tool pairing, session image registry.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — trajectory ledger core; goldens under `test/trajectory/goldens/`.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (prompt, tool args, output, logs).
- `lib/src/hashline/` — `[path#TAG]` patch language (SWAP/DEL/INS, stale-tag rejection).
- `lib/src/compaction/` — branch summarization + AutoCompactor → policy: `docs/compaction.md`.
- `lib/src/lsp/`, `lib/src/mcp/` — `lsp` + MCP protocol tooling (lazy servers, pure-Dart transports).
- `lib/src/model_roles/` — roles/fallbacks/keyring/watchdogs + provider catalog; `lib/src/ttsr/` — streaming-interrupt rules.
- `lib/src/skills/`, `lib/src/prompts/` — skills discovery; AGENTS/CLAUDE/GOAL/DESIGN auto-merge into the system prompt.

- `lib/src/skills/`, `lib/src/prompts/` — skills discovery; AGENTS/CLAUDE/GOAL/DESIGN auto-merge into the system prompt.
- `lib/src/task/`, `lib/src/messaging/`, `lib/src/session/attach/` — subagents, inbox fabric, attached sessions → `docs/subagents/README.md`.
- `lib/src/memory/` — long-term memory (hosted `flutter_agent_memory` package) → pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`.
- `lib/src/a2a/` — Agent2Agent client/server/manager (`fa serve --a2a`).
- `bin/fah.dart` + `lib/src/cli/` — the `fa` CLI: REPL, slash commands, headless/serve modes → `docs/agents/cli.md`.
- `lib/src/cube/` — fa_cube sandbox profiles → `docs/cubes.md`; `lib/src/cli/hep.dart` — HEP event protocol → `docs/hep.md`.
- `lib/src/web_search/` — `web_search` (DDG keyless → keyed providers); `tool/fa-clip/` — native macOS pasteboard helper.

**packages/ + app shells:**

- `packages/fa_ui/` — reusable widgets (incl. trajectory) → `docs/agents/fa-ui.md`; `dap_hub`, `fa_llm`, `fa_llm_mock` → `docs/dap.md`.
- `flutter_app/` — the Flutter app (desktop/mobile/web) → `docs/agents/flutter-app.md`; services one-liner: `docs/agents/services.md`; JS apps: `docs/agents/js-apps.md`; HomeKit/Calendar/CodeMie: `docs/agents/system-integrations.md`.
- `browser_ext/` + `lib/src/browser/` + `bin/serve_bridge.dart` — browser extension + WebSocket bridge → `docs/browser-extension.md`.
- `office_addin/` + FA_HOST=office app host — Office add-in → `docs/outlook-addin.md`.
- `fa_network` — external Go backend bridged via the DAP hub (channel-id caveats: `docs/dap.md` §14).
- `site/`, `scripts/`, `docs/subagents/` — landing page (privacy sync), gates + codegen, subagents master plan → `docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md`.

## Hard architecture rules (stay inline)

- `lib/` is pure Dart: **no `dart:io`** (must compile for web). The only
  `dart:io` entry points are `bin/` and `lib/io.dart`; file/process/network
  behind tools goes through the `ExecutionEnv` abstraction.
- Barrel `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart`: grouped **APPEND-ONLY** export
  sections — one `// ── <subsystem> ──` header per group, sorted by path
  within a group, new exports append to their group. No mini-barrels, no
  re-sorting (gh-1232).
- God-file ceiling: no `.dart` file over **2800** lines (crap4dart `loc`
  gate). Target < 2000 for primary files; split by concern into `part`
  files — never by extracting public API.

## Working in parallel (shared checkout + worktrees)

Do not modify files in this shared checkout unless the user asked; run no
heavy commands (full suites/analyze) in it; never `git stash` the user's
WIP; talk to peer agents through the messaging fabric, not their files.
Worktrees only if genuinely required — ask first, create detached under
`.worktrees/<name>/` from the remote tracking ref, remove when done.
Full policy: `docs/agents/parallel-worktrees.md`.

## Memory (footnote)

Before any non-trivial task, **search memory first** (`memory_search`,
then `memory_list` for fuzzy topics). Scopes: **project** = this repo
(`.fah/memory/note/` since gh-2185 — local-only, not committed; the
user's files: read freely, write only via `memory_add`), **user** = global/private. `memory_add` stores durable facts
only; supersede by delete + add — never leave solved problems to rot. The
host recomposes the `<memory>` prompt section after every add; tool wiring
is `memoryTools` + `lib/src/memory/`. Churn pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`;
usage details: `docs/agents/memory-usage.md`.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done: coverage first (`test/goldens/` + `golden_guard_test.dart`
map), real fonts (`ensureGoldenFonts`), full frames (1280x800 / 390x844),
determinism, eyes on pixels after `--update-goldens`, green
`flutter test test/goldens` + `scripts/check_goldens.py` (orphan snapshots
hard-fail). Full rules: `docs/agents/golden-tests.md`.

## Prompts live outside Dart code

Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (YAML frontmatter,
`{{token}}` placeholders) — never string literals in `.dart`. After
editing: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` regenerates the `.g.dart`
files (`test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` gates drift); Codex catalog
refresh: `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Details:
`docs/agents/prompts.md`.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The hook is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI classifies
PRs through the same script (`--dry-run`) — one classifier, one threshold
set, hook/CI parity via `GATE_STAGE` markers. Path rules: docs/markdown/
prompts-only → size + analyze; lib/bin/test/pubspec → +tests, coverage,
CRAP, dup, dupx; `test/integration/**` → +integration-mock;
flutter_app/packages → +flutter; scripts/.github → everything. Invariants:

- analyze + format clean; `dart test` green — **deterministic-only**
  (mock LLM; live models never in the gate; `llm`-tagged files run only in
  the tag-only provider smoke + nightly).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80%; jscpd < 1% core / < 3.7% app; cross-module
  dup < 0.31%; CRAP ratchet: core 12.0, app 30.0 (thresholds only-down);
  ≤ 2800 lines per `.dart` file; AGENTS.md ceiling (top of this file).
- Red-in-≥2-distinct-SHA-runs flakes quarantine via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json`; nightly keeps running quarantined files.

Full gate text: `docs/agents/quality-gates.md`; CI workflows: `docs/ci.md`.

## Cross-platform parity

Every shared setting and interactive prompt type exists on BOTH the CLI
and the Flutter app unless fundamentally impossible — then it MUST be in
`cliOnlySettings`/`appOnlySettings` (`lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart`)
with the reason; run `dart test test/parity/`. Host capabilities (issue
#1079): every host-wiring capability declares its 7-host matrix state AT
BIRTH (`on` / `off(reason)` / `transport`) via `wireAgentCore` — `off` is
invisible everywhere; extensions are declared surface, SDK invariants have
no override point. Full rules: `docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md`.

## Commits and releases

- Commit as `ai.teammate <agent.ai.native@gmail.com>` (set repo-locally);
  subjects `type(scope): ...`. Release-path automation MUST use the
  fa-release-bot GitHub App token — never a PAT or `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- Every push to main cuts an annotated tag (`scripts/auto_release.sh`);
  the tag is the single version source (pubspecs stay `0.0.0-dev`);

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/sqlite3-native-assets-prewarm
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.50\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

      # gh-1476 AC5 (PR #1479 owner directive): the GEO layer is built at
      # deploy time — gitignored, never committed, nothing to drift
      # against. So the gate builds to a temp dir and validates the
      # OUTPUT: test/site/* (no-JS crawl, robots contract, sitemap
      # integrity, JSON-LD, llms guards) serve the temp tree over loopback
      # HTTP via FA_SITE_ROOT. Stronger than the old `--check` drift gate:
      # it tests the builder itself, and hand-edited generated HTML is
      # uncommittable by construction.
      - name: GEO site build + validation (gh-1476 AC5)
        run: |
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          # The builder's post input is the site/blog/posts COPY of the
          # canonical blog/posts — keep them pinned together so the gate
          # can never validate a stale or hand-edited copy (gh-1476
          # review). PRE-sync diff: an in-place edit of the copy is red
          # (the deploy's build_blog would silently discard it). Sync,
          # then POST-sync diff: a new or edited canonical post that was
          # never copied into site/blog/posts is red.

## Automated Code Review — APPROVE (re-review round 2)

**Summary**: The #2257 verdict split is correct and now fully guarded: registry finding F1 (overlapping heartbeats double-enter viewer mode and leak the first attachment's subscription) is fixed — beats are serialized with a try/finally in-flight guard, stale beats are dropped, and a `_viewer != null` re-check closes the inspect-await window before `_enterViewerMode` — and the new regression test proves one beat, one demote, one live watch stream. Gates re-verified in this checkout: `dart analyze` clean on all five lib files, 48/48 lease + viewer tests green, `agent_cli.dart` at 2768 lines (< 2800 gate); the `dart format` delta my 3.14 sandbox SDK reports is repo-wide version drift (it reformats pre-existing main files too) — the pinned 3.13.5 accepts the committed shape.

Note on re-review scope: the hunks since the last reviewed head are almost entirely `main` merge content (#2269 image recovery, #2271 budget exclusions, ttsr cursor resync) — not this PR's delta. The PR's own work is the 4 re-touched files (`agent_cli.dart`, `agent_cli_model_caps.dart` — verbatim model-caps move for the LOC gate, `agent_cli_viewer.dart`, `agent_cli_viewer_test.dart`); `session_lease.dart` and its tests are unchanged since the last round.

**Ranked digest** (no threads — advisory):
1. `flutter_app/lib/services/flutter_session_manager.dart:1119` — the app host still discards the beat verdict (`unawaited(store.heartbeat(...))`), so a *real* loss never demotes the app surface; pre-existing and untouched here, but the store now returns a rich `LeaseBeat` the app could consume — follow-up ticket material.
2. `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart:1480` — `_leaseBeatFailures` survives `/session` switches, and since 1853a1f6 a `Lost` beat dropped by the stale guard no longer zeroes it; worst case is one early alarm on a later session (cosmetic).
3. `test/cli/agent_cli_viewer_test.dart:718` — the 450ms pile-up assertion cannot fail even without the in-flight guard (beats are ~4s apart); the test's real teeth are the one-demote/one-row assertions, which do catch the leak.

**Next Steps**:
1. Merge — no blocking or important findings remain.
2. File the app-surface beat-verdict follow-up from digest item 1.

Review complete. Working tree clean, both artifacts written and validated.

## Review verdict: APPROVE (re-review round 2)

**What this round found:**

1. **Registry finding F1 — FIXED.** The demote-path re-entry leak (overlapping heartbeats double-entering viewer mode → leaked `StreamSubscription`s) is closed by commit `71898279` + `1853a1f6`: `_leaseHeartbeat` opens with an in-flight+viewer guard (`agent_cli_viewer.dart:375`), holds `_leaseBeatInFlight` across the whole beat in try/finally, drops stale beats (`:389`), and re-checks `_viewer != null` after the inspect await (`:433`) — and `_enterViewerMode` assigns `_viewer` synchronously, so no interleaving window remains. The new regression test stalls a sidecar read across a later tick and proves exactly one beat, one demote, one live watch stream.

2. **Re-review scope disambiguation.** The hunks since the last reviewed head are almost entirely `main` merge content (#2269 image recovery, #2271 budget exclusions, ttsr) — the PR's own delta is 4 files; `session_lease.dart` is unchanged since the last round (the `pr_new_hunks.txt` tail showing session_lease rig hunks is stale; git is ground truth).

3. **Gates re-verified in this checkout:** `dart analyze` clean on all five lib files; 48/48 lease+viewer tests pass; `agent_cli.dart` at 2768 lines (< 2800 gate); the `dart format` delta my 3.14 SDK reports is repo-wide version drift (it reformats pre-existing main files too — CI pins 3.13.5, which accepts the committed shape; 163 identical pre-existing blocks).

4. **Three advisory digest items** (no threads — none pass the necessity test): the app surface still discards the beat verdict (`flutter_session_manager.dart:1119`, follow-up ticket material), the failure counter survives `/session` switches (cosmetic), and the 450ms pile-up assertion is decorative (the one-demote/one-row assertions carry the teeth).
